website_summary.name: Engineer's Toolkit Hub
website_summary.description: The website presents a clean and organized interface with a forest green theme for UI elements against an ivory background, designed specifically for engineers to find and evaluate tools.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a minimalist design with a prominent header containing the site title "Tool Information" accompanied by a logo. The header also includes a "Login" button and a "Register" button for user authentication. Below the header, there is a search bar labeled "Search tools..." for users to find specific tools. Adjacent to the search bar is a "Filters" button for refining search results. The main content area displays a message indicating no tools were found matching the current criteria, suggesting placeholders for where tool listings would appear. The overall color scheme uses forest green for buttons and borders, while the background maintains an ivory tone for a professional yet inviting look.
website_summary.functionality:
The website offers several key functionalities: 
- A search bar allows users to enter keywords related to the tools they're looking for.
- A filters option enables users to narrow down their search based on specific criteria.
- Login and register buttons facilitate user authentication, allowing access to personalized features.
- Although not visible in the screenshot, the website likely supports viewing detailed tool information, commenting, and rating tools once a match is found.

functionality_testing.name: Category Dropdown Functionality Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that selecting a category from the Category Dropdown refines the search results.
functionality_testing.preconditions: A search has been performed with no results.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The tool list should update based on the selected category.
procedure: Click on the Dropdown Arrow to open the category dropdown.
Select a specific category from the dropdown.
Observe if the tool list updates accordingly.

functionality_testing.name: Category Dropdown Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that selecting a category from the Category Dropdown filters the tool list.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The page is loaded with the category dropdown open.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The tool list should be filtered to show only tools belonging to the selected category.
procedure: Select a category from the Category Dropdown.
Verify that the tool list is updated based on the selected category.

functionality_testing.name: Category Selection Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that selecting a category from the Category Dropdown applies the filter and updates the tool list.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The page is loaded with the category dropdown open.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The tool list should be filtered to show only tools belonging to the selected category. If no tools match the selected category, the "No tools found" message should be displayed.
procedure: Select a category from the Category Dropdown.
Verify that the tool list is updated based on the selected category.

functionality_testing.name: Filters Button Functionality Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Filters Button reveals additional filter options that can refine the search.
functionality_testing.preconditions: A search has been performed with no results.
functionality_testing.expected_results: Filter options should be displayed, allowing the user to refine the search.
procedure: Observe if additional filter options are displayed.

functionality_testing.name: Search Bar Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that entering a keyword into Search Bar updates the tool list or displays a relevant message.
functionality_testing.preconditions: Website is loaded, and no search has been performed.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The tool list should either show relevant tools or display a message if no matches are found.
procedure: Type a specific tool name or keyword into the Search Bar.
Observe if the tool list updates to show relevant tools or if the message card changes.

data_display_testing.name: Category Card Display Test
data_display_testing.objective: To verify that the Category Card displays the selected category.
data_display_testing.preconditions: A category is selected from the dropdown.
data_display_testing.expected_results: The card should display the name of the selected category.
procedure: Select a category from the Category Dropdown.
Observe the content of the Category Card.
Verify that the card displays the selected category.

data_display_testing.name: No Tools Found Message Display Test
data_display_testing.objective: To verify that the No Tools Found Message card displays the correct message when no tools are found.
data_display_testing.preconditions: The page is loaded with no tools found.
data_display_testing.expected_results: The card should display the message "No tools found matching your criteria. Try adjusting your search or filter options."
procedure: Observe the content of the No Tools Found Message card.
Verify that the message indicates no tools found.

data_display_testing.name: No Tools Found Message Test
data_display_testing.objective: To verify that the message card Message Card displays the correct message when no tools are found.
data_display_testing.preconditions: No tools match the search query.
data_display_testing.expected_results: The message card should display the correct message when no tools match the search query.
procedure: Perform a search with a nonexistent tool name.
Observe if the Message Card displays the "No tools found matching your criteria" message.

element_requirement: 1. Search Bar : Text field for entering tool keywords or names
2. Filters Button : Button for accessing additional search filters
3. Message Card : Card displaying the message “No tools found matching your criteria. Try adjusting your search or filter options.”
4. Category Dropdown : Dropdown menu for selecting tool categories
5. Category Card : Card displaying the selected category
6. No Tools Found Message : Card displaying a message indicating no tools found
